description: transform reads matrix, optional nonempty numeric N's first real cell, dimension, then empty early return. For each selected slice it copies/truncates input to N, zero-pads remainder, calls rustfft forward/inverse and scales inverse by 1/N. Row vectors default dim2, others dim1; every admitted dimension other than1, including dim>=3, aliases dim2; output uses column-major indices.
forward: transform reads matrix, optional nonempty numeric N's first real cell, dimension, then empty early return. For each selected slice it copies/truncates input to N, zero-pads remainder, calls rustfft forward/inverse and scales inverse by 1/N. Row vectors default dim2, others dim1; every admitted dimension other than1, including dim>=3, aliases dim2; output uses column-major indices.
inverse: For fixed dimension and N, inverse DFT reconstructs padded/truncated complex slices up to rounding. If N<len, arbitrary tails share output; if N>len, compatible inputs must map to zero padded suffix after inverse. Narrowed imaginary storage loses representation identity.
